cohort: Pregnant and breastfeeding women in Vietnam who were reported to have clinically diagnosed rabies in 2015-2016.
finding: Six pregnant or breastfeeding women who were bitten by dogs and did not receive postexposure prophylaxis (PEP) died from rabies, primarily due to fear of risks to the fetus or breastfed child.
mod_finding: Three of the four pregnant women had cesarean deliveries; one newborn died from unrelated complications, and one pregnancy was not viable due to the timing of the rabies infection.
